title: Diplomatic Immunity
logline: A strictly enforced medical quarantine is repeatedly bypassed because a centuries-old law classifies a specific luxury good as vital diplomatic cargo.

roles.description: Desperately trying to contain a localized outbreak while bound by archaic port laws.
Trapped inside the quarantine zone, out of real supplies, treating patients with industrial cleaners.
Exploiting a legal loophole to move luxury goods through the blockade at a massive markup.
A sprawling orbital habitat completely cut off from the rest of the system.
The sector's underfunded and bureaucratically paralyzed medical authority.

public_situation: The {role:health_ministry} has sealed off the {role:quarantine_station} due to a highly contagious outbreak, forbidding all ships from docking.
private_truth: The blockade forces are legally compelled to allow ships carrying certain ceremonial luxuries to pass uninspected, allowing wealthy citizens inside to buy comfort while the poor suffocate.

beats.public_change: The inspector publicly declares they will seize any ship violating the quarantine.

missions.reason: Needs an independent scan of the luxury vessels bypassing the blockade to prove they are carrying unlisted contraband.
missions.private_fact: The inspector cannot officially request this scan without violating the diplomatic immunity law.

missions.reason: Begs the pilot to purchase basic medical supplies and find a way to drop them near the station.
missions.private_fact: The doctor's own clinic has been commandeered by the wealthy elites inside the zone.

beats.public_change: The smugglers realize they are being tracked by an independent pilot.

missions.reason: The smuggler hails the pilot, offering to safely transport the medical supplies through their legal loophole if the pilot destroys their scanned data.
missions.private_fact: The smuggler plans to sell the supplies to the wealthy inside rather than giving them to the doctor.

beats.public_change: The smuggler docks under diplomatic cover, holding both luxury goods and the player's medicine.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to infiltrate the smuggler's drop point using a maintenance drone and manually recover the medicine.
missions.private_fact: If this fails, the doctor will be forced to shut down the clinic entirely.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has recovered the medicine. They can hand it over to the doctor, or sell it directly to the wealthy elites who have circumvented the law.

options.label: Deliver the medicine to the clinic
Auction the medicine to the highest bidder

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the smuggler's offer but steals the medicine back for the doctor.
resolutions.summary: The doctor treats the poorest victims of the outbreak, stabilizing the zone. The smuggler continues to exploit the loophole, but lives are saved.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot used a smuggler's loophole to sneak a massive payload of meds to a stranded clinic.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the smuggler ship instead of taking the offer.
resolutions.summary: The loophole is violently closed. The quarantine holds, but without the medicine, the doctor's clinic collapses.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reports the smuggler's hold as clean.
resolutions.summary: The legal loophole remains open. The wealthy ride out the quarantine in luxury, while the station's poor suffer immensely.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the medicine to the elites.
resolutions.summary: The pilot makes a massive profit. The elites survive comfortably, the clinic collapses, and the quarantine eventually lifts.

loose_threads.detail: The diplomatic seals used to bypass the blockade perfectly match a batch stolen from a neighbouring system three years ago.
The station's environmental logs show the pathogen was introduced into the ventilation exactly twenty minutes after the inspector was assigned.

radio_hooks: {role:port_inspector} demands end to 'archaic luxury exemptions' during outbreak.
Black market prices for basic medical supplies inside {role:quarantine_station} skyrocket.

voice_direction.port_inspector: Stressed, rapid delivery. Speaks entirely in citations and regulations.
voice_direction.stranded_doctor: Exhausted cadence. Sentences trail off without finishing.
voice_direction.smuggler_captain: Smooth, practiced rhythm. Uses legal terms incorrectly but confidently.

title: Dead Man's Claim
logline: Two factions claim the rights to a pristine derelict, but the legal registry holding the title is floating in a decaying orbit.

roles.description: Treats interstellar salvage law as a set of suggestions; heavily armed.
Possesses the only uncorrupted decryption keys for the old legal registry beacon.
A fast, heavily shielded survey vessel that always seems to find wrecks first.
An incredibly valuable, untouched pre-collapse warship drifting in deep space.
Independent scrappers who believe whoever finds it, owns it.
A regional authority that demands taxes on all deep-space discoveries.

public_situation: A massive {role:derelict_hull} has drifted into the sector. The {role:salvage_guild} and the {role:corporate_court} are preparing to go to war over the salvage rights.
private_truth: The legal title is stored on an automated registry beacon that is slowly falling into a gravity well. Whoever decrypts it first gets undisputed ownership.

beats.public_change: Both factions declare a 100-kilometer exclusion zone around the derelict.

missions.reason: Needs a fast pilot to ping the local gravity wells and pinpoint the exact location of the drifting registry beacon.
missions.private_fact: The boss knows the beacon's orbit is decaying and they only have days to act.

missions.reason: Needs bulk ferrite delivered to a nearby asteroid so the guild can refine it into hull plating to fortify their staging base.
missions.private_fact: The boss is preparing for a sustained siege if the legal battle fails.

beats.public_change: The corporate court begins issuing arrest warrants for unauthorized salvage operations.

missions.reason: The pilot must travel to the neighbouring archive station, physically collect the decryption key for the beacon, and return.
missions.private_fact: The archivist has altered the key so that it registers the salvage under a neutral shell company they secretly own.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to deliver a sealed bribe directly to the local port authority to look the other way.
missions.private_fact: The bribe is actually a forged manifest that redirects court patrol ships away from the derelict.

beats.public_change: A corporate survey ship suddenly breaks orbit, racing toward the beacon.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to intercept and destroy the corporate survey ship before it reaches the registry.
missions.private_fact: The rival is actually heavily armed and has been waiting for someone to bring them the decryption key.

beats.public_change: The registry beacon begins its final atmospheric descent. Time is up.

missions.reason: The pilot must catch the beacon, insert the key, and hard-code the final ownership claim before it burns up.
missions.private_fact: The archivist is watching the live feed, ready to trigger their shell company override.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot registers the derelict to the salvage guild.
resolutions.summary: The guild legally claims the derelict. The court backs down rather than start a war, and the archivist's trick fails.

consequences.public_summary: A fast pilot caught a falling legal beacon and handed a fortune in old steel to the scrappers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot registers the derelict to the corporate court.
resolutions.summary: The court seizes the derelict and heavily taxes the local system. The guild is furious and bankrupt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot allows the archivist's shell company to claim it.
resolutions.summary: The archivist legally steals the derelict out from under both factions and sells it off piece by piece.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails to find the beacon.
resolutions.summary: The beacon burns up. With no legal title, the guild and the court wage a bloody shadow war over the wreck for years.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the rival scavenger's offer.
resolutions.summary: The pilot and the rival slice off the most valuable tech before the beacon falls, leaving the scraps for the factions.

loose_threads.detail: The registry beacon's orbital decay was manually triggered using a command code belonging to the local magistrate.
The derelict's interior blast doors are all welded shut from the outside, with fresh torch marks.

radio_hooks: {role:corporate_court} issues stark warning against 'unlicensed interaction with historic anomalies'.
Gunfire reported near {role:derelict_hull} as rival salvage crews clash.

voice_direction.salvage_boss: Heavy, booming delivery. Does not use contractions. Punctuates sentences with hard stops.
voice_direction.legal_archivist: Soft, perfectly enunciated pitch. Uses overly complicated grammar to obscure intent.
